newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity up as SocGen repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity up as SocGen repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in LucasVarity Plc firmed slightly ahead of the company's conference call this afternoon as SocGen repeated its "buy" recommendation, dealers said.
By 1102 GMT, the shares were up 2p to 207-1/2.
Zafar Khan, SocGen's engineering analyst, said his buy recommendation was based on his belief that the company could achieve earnings growth through cost reduction.
"Our feeling is that profits can be internally driven rather than through market conditions at the moment," Khan said.
The company is expected to report on the progress of its restructuring and comment on its dividend policy.
Worries that LucasVarity will suspend the dividend and share buybacks have weighed heavily on the shares.
In early December, the company said trading conditions were difficult, which investors interpreted as a profit warning, Khan said.
Since then, the shares have tumbled by about 17 percent.
